# livekit_agent (Resource)

Manages a LiveKit Cloud agent.

Secrets are managed separately with the `livekit_agent_secret` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "livekit_agent" "voice_assistant" {
  regions = ["us-east", "eu-west"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `regions` (Set of String) The regions the agent is deployed to. Leave unset to let LiveKit Cloud pick a default region. Until the agent has a deployment, the configured value is kept as is.

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (String) The agent ID assigned by LiveKit Cloud. Identical to `id`.
- `agent_name` (String) The agent name. Not settable through the API.
- `deployed_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last deployment.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.
- `version` (String) The currently deployed agent version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import livekit_agent.voice_assistant CA_xxxxxxxxxxxx
```
